skill.description: Operate the agent-email CLI to create disposable inboxes, poll for new mail, retrieve full message details, and manage local mailbox profiles.

security_audit.summary: The review confirmed the skill intentionally runs the agent-email CLI, jq, and a global npm or bun install path. Most static alerts are Markdown false positives, and no prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Global installation of a community CLI package
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before npm or bun installation, and prefer a pinned package version when possible.

remediation.issue: External command execution with mailbox identifiers
remediation.suggestion: Use fixed command forms, quote email and message identifiers, and avoid shell interpolation for untrusted values.

remediation.issue: Sensitive mailbox content may appear in command output
remediation.suggestion: Continue omitting password and token fields, and summarize only the email fields needed for the task.

content.value_statement: Agents often need a temporary inbox to receive verification messages without manual browser work. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the agent-email CLI to create inboxes, poll mail, and inspect messages.
actual_capabilities: Verifies agent-email CLI availability with command and help checks.
Installs the agent-email package through npm or bun when missing.
Creates mailbox accounts and records email, account id, and active status.
Reads latest inbox messages with wait, interval, limit, and full payload options.
Shows or deletes individual messages by email alias and message id.
Lists, switches, and removes local mailbox profiles.
limitations: Requires the agent-email CLI and network access.
May install a community npm package if the CLI is missing.
Only manages mailboxes supported by agent-email.
Message contents and verification codes can be sensitive.

use_cases.title: Test Signup Flows
use_cases.description: Create a disposable inbox, receive product emails, and inspect verification messages during application testing.

use_cases.title: Automate Agent Verification
use_cases.description: Let an agent wait for incoming mail and extract the message fields needed for a workflow.

use_cases.title: Manage Temporary Inboxes
use_cases.description: List active mailbox profiles, switch defaults, delete processed mail, and remove accounts when work is complete.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Inbox
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new disposable mailbox.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-email to create a new disposable inbox. Summarize the email address and account id only.

prompt_templates.title: Wait for a Message
prompt_templates.scenario: Poll the default mailbox for recent mail.
prompt_templates.prompt: Poll the default inbox for up to 30 seconds. Return the sender, subject, created time, and message id.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a Verification Email
prompt_templates.scenario: Extract a specific link or code from a message.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the latest verification email in the default inbox. Open the full message and extract only the verification link or code.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Up Profiles
prompt_templates.prompt: List available agent-email accounts, switch to the requested mailbox, delete irrelevant messages, and remove profiles only after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Create a new inbox for a product signup test.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the new address, account id, and active mailbox status. Secret fields are omitted.

output_examples.input: Wait for a verification email in the default inbox.
output_examples.output: The response lists the latest sender, subject, received time, and message id. It notes when no matching mail arrives before timeout.

output_examples.input: Open the newest message and remove it after use.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes the relevant body content, extracts the requested link, and confirms deletion only when asked.

best_practices: Confirm before installing the CLI or deleting messages.
Return only needed mail fields and omit password or token values.
Use the default alias only when the user has not specified an address.
anti_patterns: Running install commands without user awareness.
Printing full message bodies when only a code or link is needed.
Deleting accounts or messages without an explicit request.

faq.question: Does this skill require the agent-email CLI?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks for the CLI and can guide installation when the command is missing.

faq.question: Can it create disposable inboxes?
faq.answer: Yes. It creates mailbox accounts and reports the email address, account id, and active status.

faq.question: Does it print secrets from mailbox output?
faq.answer: The skill instructs agents not to print password or token fields from command output.

faq.question: Can it wait for incoming email?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports polling with wait and interval options for recent inbox messages.

faq.question: Can it manage multiple inboxes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list accounts, switch the active mailbox, and remove profiles when requested.

faq.question: Is it suitable for personal email?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for disposable workflow inboxes, not personal or highly sensitive email.
